subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the four stale assertions are repaired, should the CodeQL and create-github-app-token updates remain grouped with the other action bumps?
rationale: Those actions execute in security-scanning and credential-minting workflows owned by the security team, so the desired review and rollback scope requires human owner intent.

options.title: Keep grouped update
options.body: Approve the verified immutable pins together after the assertion fixes and green exact-head validation.

options.title: Split privileged actions
options.body: Move CodeQL and app-token updates into a separate security-reviewed PR for narrower rollback scope.

recommendation.title: Keep grouped update
recommendation.body: Approve the verified immutable pins together after the assertion fixes and green exact-head validation.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest individual history signal across central workflow policy, while CODEOWNERS assigns the security-sensitive paths to a team rather than a person.
